blocks.name: register_file
blocks.responsibility: Implement the 32-entry RV32 register file with two asynchronous read ports, one synchronous write port, asynchronous reset, and hardwired x0 reads and writes.
blocks.design_rationale: A dedicated register-file block makes reset behavior, x0 semantics, and write timing straightforward to verify while keeping the CPU control logic compact.

blocks.name: immediate_generator
blocks.responsibility: Generate correctly sign-extended I, S, B, and J immediates and the zero-extended U immediate from the instruction word.
blocks.design_rationale: Centralizing immediate bit mapping reduces duplicated wiring and makes each instruction format independently verifiable.

blocks.name: alu
blocks.responsibility: Perform RV32I integer arithmetic, logic, shifts, signed and unsigned comparisons, and all RV32M multiply, divide, and remainder operations. Produce branch comparison results for all six conditional branch types.
blocks.design_rationale: Isolating arithmetic and comparison behavior makes opcode and funct decoding easier to test, including the defined RV32M corner cases.

blocks.name: cpu
blocks.responsibility: Implement the single-cycle RV32IM processor top level: expose the contract bus ports, maintain and update the PC, decode instructions, instantiate the register_file, immediate_generator, and alu blocks, select writeback results, and drive load/store addresses, widths, and store data. Support LUI, AUIPC, JAL, JALR, all conditional branches, byte/halfword/word loads and stores, and all listed RV32I and RV32M operations.
blocks.design_rationale: Keeping PC sequencing, bus behavior, and instruction-level control at the top level preserves the specified interface and makes one-instruction-per-clock execution easy to validate.

notes: The CPU is fixed to RV32IM and uses asynchronous instruction and data reads with architectural state updated on the rising clock edge.
